thread:
jamie_csm: FYI — large customer (AcmeApps) just flagged their per-model throughput charts are showing zero for several models since ~04:10 UTC. API telemetry for the same models shows normal traffic. Customer is frustrated, asked for update asap. Screenshot attached: https://snip.example/throughput-zero.png :exclamation:

alex_eng: ugh. did we run the label migration last night? I remember a labels-change deploy at ~03:40UTC.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: labels-migration v2.3.1 deployed to prod at 03:45:12 UTC (change set: metric label key rename model->model_name) :white_check_mark:

mira_sre: can confirm dashboards use promql against `model` label. if the metric key changed to `model_name` that would drop series from current grafana panels.

sam_support: customer says errors in Console analytics page show "No data" and the per-model cards are flatlined, not just delayed. They sent a CSV of request counts which matches normal traffic.

pranav_platform: quick check — running promql to see series cardinality
```
# current query on dashboard
sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total{env="prod",route!~"internal.*"}[5m])) by (model)
```
pranav_platform: when I run a variation by `(model_name)` I get returned series for the same time window.

alex_eng: so dashboards are still querying `model`. pipeline that scrubs/rewrites labels ran earlier and renamed them. that explains missing cards. seems the ingestion side normalized to `model_name` during migration.

jamie_csm: customer is asking if this is why their per-model billing shows gaps. They see no change on billing API but console graphs look broken. They want ETA to fix dashboard visuals.

mira_sre: short term fix: we can update the grafana panels/gql translation used by Console to OR both labels, e.g. `coalesce` or fallback to `model_name`. longer term: we should push a compatibility shim in the metrics exporter to emit both labels for a transition window.

sam_support: proposed response to customer: "We're aware — dashboard is querying an old metric label. Immediate fix in progress, won't affect billing/costs, working on restoring visual continuity ASAP." ok to send? :+1:

alex_eng: agree. I'll open an internal PR to change the dashboard queries — low risk. also filing infra ticket to emit compatibility labels from exporter.

pranav_platform: created ticket PLAT-1987: 'Compatibility labels for metrics after label-key migration' and PR #452 to update console queries to check both keys. Rolling a patch to grafana templates in staging now.

ops-bot: ci-bot: rollout job 452 started (patch: console/dashboard/model_throughput_label_fallback)

mira_sre: workaround timeline: patch -> deploy -> validate dashboards in ~15-30m depending on CI. If customer needs faster, we can revert the migration but that's heavier.

jamie_csm: customer "would prefer a quick fix in the console if possible" — please prioritize. I'm on standby to reply.

alex_eng: pushing quick dashboard change now, will ping when panels show data.

pranav_platform: verification steps for SRE/QA:
1) run promql `sum by (model,model_name)(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[5m]))` to confirm both labels present
2) load console per-model view for AcmeApps org id 8921 and confirm non-zero per-model lines
3) check billing export for any missing tokens in time window 03:30-05:00UTC

mira_sre: ran step 1 & 2 in staging after patch applied — panels are back, I can see per-model traces for the affected models.

sam_support: customer updated: "Thanks, we see the graphs back for now. Please confirm root cause and steps to prevent recurrence."

alex_eng: root cause = label rename in metrics pipeline without backward compatibility in Console queries. Remediation: 1) short-term query fallback (PR #452), 2) metrics exporter/shim to emit old label for 30 days (ticket PLAT-1987), 3) run post-migration checklist for future label changes (doc link https://internal.redwood/plat/metric-migrations).

pranav_platform: assigning PLAT-1987 to me, ETA for exporter shim = 3 days. Dashboard patch already deployed to prod.

jamie_csm: I replied to customer with the above summary and asked if they want a postmortem. They said yes.

mira_sre: can someone add incident type "dashboard-data-loss" to the postmortem template? I'll collect queries and screenshots.

alex_eng: adding notes to the incident board. closing thread when PR merged and shim scheduled.

sam_support: thanks team — leaving this open until PLAT-1987 is in progress and customer confirmed final closure. :white_check_mark:
